inodeSemantics.sourceBasis: The complete 5af2 advisory reads the official Node v24.22.1 fs.lstatSync({bigint:true}) source path: libuv's uint64 inode is copied through the stats population into a signed BigInt64Array slot, and BigIntStats preserves that raw field. It pins ten full source bodies and the release commit. This supports the signed-versus-unsigned representation diagnosis, not source-to-binary reproducibility.
inodeSemantics.selectedRule: Only in exactNode: retain raw metadata.inode; validate raw BigInt lies within signed64 and unchanged expected pin within unsigned64; derive BigInt.asUintN(64, raw) and compare decimal value to the existing pin; return both raw and canonical inode evidence. Generic metadata/source/control censuses stay raw. No Number conversion or expected-pin replacement.
inodeSemantics.mathematicalReason: On the finite signed64 domain, adding 2^64 to a negative integer and retaining a nonnegative integer maps bijectively to unsigned64. BigInt.asUintN(64, raw) performs that mapping. Validating both domains before comparison avoids accepting out-of-range aliases. The selected expected inode is unchanged; no precision-losing Number operation is involved.
inodeSemantics.canonicalStringBoundary: The raw value is produced by String(s.ino), and the expected pin is an immutable canonical decimal literal. This is not a general-purpose permissive parser or a selected normalization of source/control metadata.
inodeSemantics.evidenceBoundary: Return the raw metadata together with the derived canonical inode in the local Node evidence. Keep every generic metadata/census/fstat comparison raw. All callers' existing before/after equality must remain in the later exact implementation.

actualHelperSemantics: Query the selected descendant spans and filter exact trimmed text. Require exactly one match; absence and duplicates return null to the existing waitRead.
Read positive element dimensions and the nearest vertically scrollable ancestor, clipping its vertical viewport to the browser viewport.
When requireCenterHit is true, the name center's elementFromPoint result must be the selected span or its descendant before visible can be accepted.

If already fully vertically contained with an eligible center hit, return without a wheel. Otherwise use existing physical Input.dispatchMouseEvent mouseWheel, clamped ±600, and the original100 ms cadence.

At most twelve wheels are allowed, followed by one final observation. Persistent occlusion/zero dimensions/missing matches cannot authorize a click. A center obstructed by unrelated content can consume bounded wheel attempts and still fail.
Each read retains its own30,000 ms cutoff. The helper does not impose one cumulative30,000 ms reveal deadline and does not cancel an unresolved evaluate.
